edges.fact: The Simple Dill Pickle Recipe uses a traditional lacto-fermentation method, making it easy to prepare with minimal equipment.
The Simple Dill Pickle Recipe calls for 1/4 cup of kosher salt as an ingredient in the brine.
Lacto-fermentation of pickles occurs when natural bacteria on the cucumbers, like Lactobacillus plantarum, feed on the sugars present in the cucumbers and produce lactic acid.
Kosher salt plays a crucial role in lacto-fermentation by inhibiting unwanted microorganisms, providing a source of nutrients for beneficial bacteria, and enhancing flavor.
